title: I need some opinions on what menu is better
author: shoukachidev
selftext:
hello everyone,

  
i am currently working on my 3D TD game and unsure, what style for main menu i should go with.

First one is the potential new one. Second one is the current one. It has this 3D render kinda style with the ingame models, which at first i really liked but over the time working on the game, i think they dont look that well anymore.

I also plan to rework the UI, photos of old and new are also attached.

Please let me know, which one you prefer. Thank you! 

![img](2e4iwz4qfm2i1 "new")

![img](b6ab955qfm2i1 "old")

![img](nt5kgeg0hm2i1 "old")

![img](gyc02yhdhm2i1 "new")

comments.author: ZyronZA
comments.body:
My vote:

* First image (no contest)
* Fourth image

comments.author: lucianw
comments.body: Both first two choices give me the vibe "this is going to be like a mobile game that has scammy tricks to get me to pay more money". The first looks generic, the second looks like it has character.

replies.author: shoukachidev
replies.body:
a mobile version is indeed planned, but currently pc only.  
Also no micro transactions ever in the game, dont want to make any money with it. Just doing it for fun

comments.author: horsewitnoname
comments.body: First and fourth. Both look awesome!

comments.author: New_Complaint5282
comments.body:
The right aligned menu makes me go crazy 🤪   
In general new are better. Gameplay ui - top bar from old though. In general in gameplay texts seem to be positioned quite randomly within the buttons, that doesn’t look polished.   
Don’t get me wrong though - this looks quite pleasant!

replies.author: shoukachidev
replies.body:
where would you put the alignment? in the middle seems kinda stiff.  
Thank you for your feedback! yes, positions are pretty random tho, just imported it and have to polish and test it still

replies.author: New_Complaint5282
replies.body: I’d say normally it’s either left or center. I’d go left. But that’s just a personal preference, i don’t think there is anything wrong with right alignment tbh.

comments.author: PoleTree
comments.body: the new ones look better but the main menu image looks a little too detailed/busy and the font on the game play looks weird, especially the 8.

replies.author: shoukachidev
replies.body: i am also not very fond of the font so far, will change it again. Thanks!
